_notes: Add more items to 'mcq' (up to 100) and 'programs' (up to 15) following the same shape.
allowedLanguages controls which languages the STUDENT can pick from for that program (any subset of python, java, c, cpp). Omit the field entirely to allow all four.
There is no per-question starter code anymore — each language gets a generic starter skeleton built into the app, and the student writes their solution in whichever language they choose.
testCases[].expectedOutput must be identical regardless of which language is used, since input/output behavior (stdin -> stdout) is what's being checked, not the code itself.
testCases[].expectedOutput is compared after trimming trailing whitespace/newlines on both sides.
marks is per-question weight used to compute the total score.
This file is loaded directly by index.html and admin.html — no upload step needed, just edit and push to GitHub.
